description: This file contains a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that transforms raw aggregate records into a dataset suitable for visualization with Recharts. It processes records with agent names, optional environment or cost categories, and total costs, producing a grouped dataset with zero-filled categories for consistency across agents.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw data records into a grouped dataset for visualization, organizing data by agent and an optional secondary dimension, ensuring consistency across categories with zero-filled values.
